title: StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X→S and a geometric point s, let I be the small representative category of affine pointed etale neighbourhoods. Define N:I→S_et, D(i)=N(i)×_S X and its projections t to X. StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry consists of a limiting cone with vertex X×_S S_(s), qcqs stages, affine transitions and cone legs whose two pullback components are the strict-henselization cone leg and the projection to X. The first-component equation canonically fixes the cone; no cohomology occurs.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure-sheaf stalks and ordinary module pullback; none realizes these abelian derived-section maps. Loogle presheafToSheaf, homology and IsPullback, IsAffineHom queries returned no hits.

Mathlib has general stalk and pullback infrastructure, but no strict-local derived mate or the canonical derived Hom-to-germ comparison. The existing AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf has private definitions of the comparison, inaccessible from another module.
